notes:
- 13 guns rebuilt as realistic models (smooth, real-sized parts with real finishes: polymer, blued and
  bare steel, walnut, brass, rubber) instead of 1 cm voxels: Rattler SMG, Vanguard AR, Boomstick, Grinder
  LMG, Tri-Burst Carbine, Hornet PDW, Stalker 12, Twin Barrels, Warden DMR, Mag-50, Buzzsaw, Thumper and
  Bolt Thrower. Stocks, grips and the AR's curved magazine have proper shaped outlines (drop stocks,
  finger grooves, banana mag), with rails, vents, M-LOK slots, bipods, ammo belts and so on.
- Everything works as before: the same moving parts (mags, charging handles, pumps, bolts, the Twin
  Barrels and Thumper breaking open, the Buzzsaw's spinning barrels), hand positions, iron sights and aim
  line, camos and the realistic attachments.
- Still voxel for now: the Hand Cannon (its revolver cylinder animation) and the wonder weapons (Arc
  Zapper, Cryo Freezer, Seal Launcher).
